plan.notes: La Sierra University is on the quarter system; 12 quarters sequenced as published in the official 'Guided Pathway Sustainability & Society BA' PDF (lasierra.edu/fileadmin/documents/title-v/sustainability-program/guided-pathway-sustainability-society-ba.pdf). Total Units Required: 190. MATH 0X7 'Intermediate Algebra or Intermediate Algebra Emporium II' (4 units) appears in the official Year 1 Fall sequencing but is a developmental placement course: it is absent from the Required Course Listings and the 190-unit degree total equals the full sequencing minus exactly those 4 units, so it is excluded from this seed. Repeated codes (UNST 101 x3, elct X00, GE7 X00 x2, GE6-IDEI X00 x2) are distinct enrollments/elective slots as sequenced. Prereqs encoded only for direct numbered sequences (ENGL 111>112>113); other star-marked courses have prerequisites per the source but the source does not name them, so no further prereqs are invented. A total of 12 IDEI units and 2 service-learning courses are required per the source; service-learning slots are sequenced (UNST 404U-SL, elct X00-SL). Dagger-marked courses are offered only in odd/even years as noted in the source.
